How a consultation works here

Homoeopathy looks at the person, not only the complaint. That shapes how we listen, what we ask and how we follow up with you over time.

Individualised care

Every person experiences illness differently. Consultations focus on understanding your individual symptom picture rather than treating everyone in exactly the same way.

Mind and body together

Physical health and emotional well-being are closely connected. Both the physical and the personal aspects of your health are considered during consultation.

A detailed first visit

Time is taken to understand your concerns, medical history, lifestyle and relevant symptoms before an individualised approach is worked out with you.

Patient-centred follow-up

Open communication is encouraged, so your progress and any new concerns can be reviewed together over the course of treatment.

Conditions we consult for

The clinic provides homoeopathic consultations for a range of health concerns, including:

Skin complaints
Respiratory and recurrent complaints
Digestive complaints
Allergic complaints
Headaches and migraine
Musculoskeletal complaints
Women's health concerns
Men's health concerns
Children's health concerns
Stress-related and lifestyle concerns
Autoimmune conditions
Hormonal imbalance
Other chronic and recurring complaints

Not sure whether your concern fits? Send a message on WhatsApp and the clinic will let you know whether a consultation is appropriate for you.

Three generations, one commitment to healing

Homoeopathy has been part of our family for three generations. What began with my grandfather continues today at Izhai Homoeo Clinic.

Grandfather · First generation

Dr. Arumugam, RHMP

He was the first in our family to practise homoeopathy, laying the foundation for our family's journey in this field.

Mother · Second generation

Dr. Poonkothai, BHMS

Continuing that journey, my mother established Sri Homoeo Clinic in Madhanandhapuram, where she continues to serve patients through homoeopathic practice.

Third generation · Izhai Homoeo Clinic

Dr. Amarnath, BHMS

Inspired by the generations before me, I have chosen to continue this journey through Izhai Homoeo Clinic, bringing together traditional homoeopathic values with a thoughtful, individualised approach to patient care.

From one generation to the next, the commitment remains the same — to listen, to understand and to care.
